correctness.rationale: Invertibility forces isomorphisms to be monomial; the action is g^{-1}Ag^(2). The proof bounds all nonidentity stabilizers by disjoint σ != 1, σ = 1 with <= n/2 nonunit diagonal values, and σ = 1 with > n/2. Coordinate-orbit and forced-zero codimensions prove the three explicit estimates. Conditioning by the finite-field GL density bounded below by c_q>0, then applying Burnside and orbit-stabilizer, proves the statements. Exact finite checks reproduce small-dimensional orbit counts.
